description: List receiving domains: domains and subdomains whose mail reaches the inbox (every address on them). A workspace has one; once verified, replies to emails from all its sending domains come back to reply addresses on it, like the tracking domain. Workspaces that set up several before keep them; replies then prefer the sender's own domain or one on the same root, else the oldest verified one. status verified: mail arrives and new reply addresses use it. pending: publish its records (a new name is reserved 7 days); until then replies use Sequenzy's shared address. failed: something broke; mail that still arrives is accepted, but new reply addresses use Sequenzy's address until fixed.
